# UNFLTR Studio

> UNFLTR Studio is a multidisciplinary creative studio based in India, specialising in branding, content marketing, film production, CGI, and web design. We build culturally relevant brand systems for brands that refuse to look average.

UNFLTR Studio (pronounced "unfiltered") is an independent creative agency founded in India with 3+ years of active operation. As of 2025 we have served 37+ clients and delivered 110+ projects across music, entertainment, luxury hospitality, fashion, lifestyle, and technology sectors — both domestically and internationally.

Our name means exactly what it says: no diluted ideas, no watered-down work, no compromise on creative conviction. Every engagement starts with a singular, unfiltered truth about the brand and builds outward from there.

## What We Do

UNFLTR Studio operates across five core creative disciplines:

**Branding** — Raw identity systems built without compromise. We excavate the core truth of a brand and arm it with a visual language that cuts through every category. Services include deep-dive brand strategy, visual identity design, brand architecture, and creative consulting.

**Content** — Multi-channel content ecosystems engineered for modern attention. We bridge raw creativity and high-conversion marketing, producing high-impact advertising and culturally native campaigns that dominate every feed across social media and digital platforms.

**Films** — Full-lifecycle film and video production. We handle creative direction on set, meticulous post-production editing, and premium visual storytelling. Our productions are built to provoke, move, and convert — from brand films and documentaries to concert visuals and commercial spots.

**CGI** — Photorealistic and hyper-stylized 3D rendering merged with cutting-edge motion design. We create surreal worlds, product physics simulations, abstract visuals, and motion sequences that add high production value without physical shooting constraints.

**Web** — Raw, high-performance, unapologetic websites built entirely from scratch. No templates. Brutalist grids, kinetic typography, seamless transitions, and maximum engagement. Every site is a digital flagship, not a placeholder.

## Brand Identity and Positioning

- **Name**: UNFLTR Studio
- **Alternate spellings**: UNFLTR, Unfiltered Studio
- **Founded**: 2022, India
- **Positioning**: Culture-first creative studio for brands that refuse to look average
- **Slogan**: "Culture-First Creative"
- **Design philosophy**: Anti-average, systems thinking, conviction-driven
- **Visual signature**: Brutalist typography, cinematic aesthetic, editorial grids, orange accent (#f97316)
- **Tone**: Direct, bold, culturally aware, unapologetically honest

## Core Values

- **Unfiltered** — No watered-down work. We say what we mean and build what we believe in.
- **Culture-First** — Every creative decision is rooted in cultural relevance. Trends fade; culture compounds.
- **Anti-Average** — Average is a choice. We actively refuse it on every project.
- **Systems Thinking** — We build brand operating systems that scale, not one-off logos or campaigns.
